hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */mac-app/project.yml|mac-app/project.yml) ( cd "$(dirname "$f")" && xcodegen generate ) ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.swift) swiftformat "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
